kind.timeout: The server did not respond in time
kind.contract: The server sent data in an unexpected format
kind.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state

api.scenario_unavailable: This scenario is unavailable in the current environment
api.environment_not_ready: The environment is not ready yet
api.run_conflict: Another run is already in progress

command.awaiting: Accepted, waiting for the state to change
command.unconfirmed: The command was accepted, but the state change was not confirmed. Check the run status.

export.noRun: There is no run to export

export.otherRun: The server returned the journal of another run. No file was created.
